messages.subject: išče se junior/senior dejta sajentist
messages.body_plain:
Na linkedinu sem naletel na oglasi, ki bi bil morda primeren tudi za koga s te mailing liste. Morda pa poznate koga, ki bi ga ta tip dela zanimal?

https://www.linkedin.com/jobs/view/1513300237

Podjetje seveda klasično ne navede vseh pogojev dela, vključno z razponom za plačo. Ti ti.

> Requested/Expected characteristics:
> passionate about artificial intelligence and machine learning, any experience is appreciated
> curious about constructing and training predictive models like neural networks, SVM, random forests etc.
> basic knowledge of Statistics
> some experience with computer programming, preferably Python or Node.js
> experience with scientific programming, preferably Python or R, is a plus
> experience with SQL and NoSQL databases, is a plus
> good knowledge of Slovenian and English language
> preferable Phd in Matematics
> Tasks:
> cleaning and processing large amounts of data, stored in relational and NoSQL databases or extracted from the web
> text processing, classification and other kinds of text mining tasks, preferably with Python or Node.js
> profiling users according to their behaviour on the web
> user characterization/classification according to their profiles
>  The job offers:
> work in a young and innovative environment in a team of young professionals,
>     cooperation in the fields of project development (big-data, artificial intelligence and behavior prediction models, including multimedia, web and mobile technologies)
> tidy and relaxed work environment near BTC in Ljubljana
> opportunities for ongoing professional and personal development.

lp,
Roman

--
In God we trust, all others bring data.

messages.subject: FW: Invitation to the 3rd International Statistical Conference in Croatia (ISCCRO’20), Dubrovnik, Croatia, May 7-8, 2020
messages.subject_clean: Invitation to the 3rd International Statistical Conference in Croatia (ISCCRO’20), Dubrovnik, Croatia, May 7-8, 2020
messages.body_plain:
Sent from my Windows 10 device

From: HSD_ISCCRO_Int. Statistical Conference in Croatia<mailto:confe...@hsd-stat.hr>
Sent: Thursday, 31 October 2019 13:22
To: bz...@net.efzg.hr<mailto:bz...@net.efzg.hr>
Subject: Invitation to the 3rd International Statistical Conference in Croatia (ISCCRO’20), Dubrovnik, Croatia, May 7-8, 2020

Dear ISCCRO'16 participants,
Dear ISCCRO'18 participants,
Dear friends of the International Statistical Conference in Croatia,

We are proud that we can inform you about The 3rd International Statistical Conference in Croatia (ISCCRO’20) which is going to take place in Dubrovnik, Croatia in May 2020.

We hope that you are going to take into consideration our warm invitation and that we are going to meet in Dubrovnik next year again.

You can participate at the conference as an author of paper or an author of abstract. You can take a part in the conference just as an accompanying person as well.

Basic information about the conference are provided in the attached document whereas detailed information can be found at http://www.hsd-stat.hr/en/international-statistical-conference-in-croatia-isccro20/

We would be very thankful to you if you could spread the word about the ISCCRO’20 among your colleagues.

If you want to participate in organisation of the conference or if you have any other inquiries, please do not hesitate to contact us.

ISCCRO'20 Organizing Committee

--
ISCCRO’20 Scientific & Organizing Committees
The 3rd International Statistical Conference in Croatia, ISCCRO'20, 7-8 May 2020, Dubrovnik, Croatia
ISCCRO’20: http://www.hsd-stat.hr/en/international-statistical-conference-in-croatia-isccro20/
